name: proposal applies on top of all repo migrations with existing rows
backfill: every project gets epoch 1; historical runs stay NULL (unknown), nothing inferred
member-created run is stamped with the current epoch and customer_cycle; client value ignored
service-role run without explicit origin stays unknown; explicit fixture is kept
question-set epoch: reword/retire/add bump; inactive-only edits and no-op updates do not; sibling project untouched
run cycle identity is immutable (analyst has runs write policy, still cannot rewrite)
project epoch table is read-only to members and invisible across orgs
answer observation method/sampling derive only from raw_json; direct edits cannot drift; missing stays NULL
save_record_decision: analyst saves explicit no-action; same-key replay returns the same row (lost ACK)
same save key for a different Record is a conflict (PT409), not an overwrite
tenant/project/role denials: viewer, other org ids, sibling project, other-org project, outsider
no-action/disagreement cannot carry an owner; analyst cannot approve; bad save key rejected
Change Specification decision: saved incomplete, approval requires owner+action+date, then immutable
direct table writes are denied to members; reads are org-scoped
service role cannot rewrite a saved decision body either (trigger)
RPC execute grants: authenticated + service_role only
org deletion cascades decisions and epochs (deletion graph not blocked)
